sources.name: Topography Feature Lifecycles and Tracking Change
sources.role: persistent feature identity and capture-threshold contract
verified_facts: Feature lifecycles are matched where possible to real-world objects, while minor physical changes may be below the capture threshold.
semantic_limits: An unchanged TOID does not prove unchanged geometry, classification, source date or suitability for current parcel analysis.

sources.name: Topography Polygon Feature Lifecycle Rules
sources.role: polygon insert, update, delete and COU notification contract
verified_facts: Polygon lifecycle rules distinguish insertion, modification and removal and communicate applicable changes through COU supplies.
semantic_limits: The latest feature alone does not prove every intermediate state, and unordered COU application can corrupt a local holding.

sources.name: Topography Geometry Mapping
sources.role: GeoPackage, vector-tile and GML geometry-type mapping contract
verified_facts: Boundary and topographic lines map to line geometries, topographic areas to polygons and point or cartographic features to points across formats.
semantic_limits: Equivalent geometry type names across encodings do not prove byte-equivalent coordinates, ring validity or identical precision.

sources.name: Topography Change-Only Update Overview
sources.role: GML-only latest insert/update/delete and no-intermediate-version contract
verified_facts: COU is available for GML orders and contains latest inserts, updates and departed features rather than all intermediate feature versions.
semantic_limits: COU must not be loaded as a standalone full supply or replayed without an idempotent base-version and sequence check.

sources.name: Topography Standard Styling Specification
sources.role: descriptive-group, descriptive-term, make and portrayal contract
verified_facts: The standard styling specification combines descriptive group, descriptive term and make to define fonts, colours, fills and symbols.
semantic_limits: Styling controls portrayal only; rendered appearance must not be parsed as source geometry, classification truth or elevation.

sources.name: Topography Downloads
sources.role: support catalogue, stylesheet and XML-schema download contract
verified_facts: The downloads page provides support resources including the real-world object catalogue, stylesheets and XML application schema links.
semantic_limits: Support resources are not the ordered Topography Layer distribution and cannot serve as feature or measurement receipts.

sources.name: Topography Release Notes
sources.role: release history, known-data-issue and FVDS validation contract
verified_facts: Release notes describe current and recent releases and direct service interruptions or data issues to the known-issues page.
semantic_limits: A release note or FVDS expectation does not prove that the local files match the release or that all COUs were applied correctly.

sources.name: Building Height Attribute Documentation
sources.role: building-height product scope, sample and documentation-navigation contract
verified_facts: Building Height Attribute is an enhancement to OS MasterMap Topography Layer with overview, technical, sample and download resources.
semantic_limits: Documentation or sample availability does not prove coverage for a target building or a valid TOID-version join.

sources.name: Building Height Attribute Overview
sources.role: national building and selected-structure height enhancement contract
verified_facts: The overview describes Building Height Attribute as an enhancement to Topography Layer for buildings and selected structures.
semantic_limits: Building or structure heights are not bare-earth parcel terrain heights and must remain separate from EA DTM extrema.

sources.name: Building Height Attribute Product Details
sources.role: photogrammetric DTM/DSM derivation and absolute-maximum role contract
verified_facts: BHA values are generated from photogrammetric DTM and DSM data; AbsHMax is the highest DSM point inside the represented building footprint.
semantic_limits: A DSM building maximum can include rooftop structures and must not be compared directly with bare-earth parcel max-minus-min.

sources.name: Building Height Attribute Product Data
verified_facts: The product-data page identifies the downloadable header resource and illustrates BHA alongside Terrain and imagery products.
semantic_limits: A header or visual overlay does not prove row presence, join success, field units or measurement provenance.

sources.name: Building Height Attribute Product Supply Information
verified_facts: BHA is supplied by online download in 5km tiles.
semantic_limits: One tile or a tile reference is not a complete national holding and does not prove all corresponding TOIDs have height values.
